name: prtg-mcp
description: Every PRTG API v2 endpoint, plus a fleet view across every client's PRTG core: alarms, status, handoffs, hygiene and safe bulk actions in one command.

prtg_api_key.title: PRTG_API_KEY
prtg_api_key.description: API key for your PRTG core (PRTG: Account Settings > My Account > API Keys), sent as a Bearer token.

prtg_server.title: PRTG_SERVER
prtg_server.description: Your PRTG core's host and API v2 port, for example prtg.example.com:1616 (the CLI connects over https).

prtg_fleet_keys.title: PRTG fleet keys (optional)
prtg_fleet_keys.description: Optional. API keys for the cores you registered with 'prtg-cli core add', as name=key pairs separated by commas (acme=KEY1,globex=KEY2). Needed only for the fleet tools. Leave blank for one core.

prtg_core.title: Pin to one registered core (optional)
prtg_core.description: Optional. Name of a core registered with 'prtg-cli core add' to point every single-core tool at. Leave blank to use PRTG_SERVER.

prtg_base_url.title: PRTG API base URL (optional)
prtg_base_url.description: Optional. Full API v2 base URL, for example https://prtg.example.com:1616/api/v2. Overrides PRTG_SERVER when set. Leave blank to use PRTG_SERVER.

prtg_skip_tls_verify.title: Skip TLS verification (optional)
prtg_skip_tls_verify.description: Optional. Set to true only for a PRTG core with a self-signed certificate. Leave blank to verify certificates.

prtg_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
prtg_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to your PRTG core. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Optional. Binds the MCP server to one saved client profile. Leave blank for the default.

prtg_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
prtg_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

prtg_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
prtg_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and nothing is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

prtg_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
prtg_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
